A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a QSP platform for the discovery of novel therapeutics and the repurposing of approved drugs for the treatment of diseases that have a high prevalence and/or mortality.

we have successfully integrated the QSP platform to enable a new paradigm of precision medicine for the discovery and development of drugs to treat patients suffering from diseases that have been refractory to current therapeutic approaches.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the integration of experimental and computational approaches in a QSP-driven drug discovery platform will help to accelerate and de-risk the drug discovery and development process, which will lead to the identification of new therapeutic opportunities and the repurposing of existing drugs for the treatment of diseases for which there are no effective therapies.
the integration of QSP into the drug discovery process can help to improve the efficiency of drug development and the success rates of drug candidates in clinical trials.
the QSP approach can be successfully used to address the innovation challenge in drug discovery and the advancement of personalized medicine.
